verdict.rationale: Token2 publishes no documented public API: all OpenAPI/Swagger candidate paths return 404. The closest programmatic surface is the open-source, libfido2-based fido2-manage command-line tool, which covers passkey, PIN, biometric and SSH-key operations and can export device info and relying parties as JSON or CSV. The Entra bulk-enrollment tool drives Microsoft's Graph API, not a Token2 API, so it is not credited. missing for 10: a documented public API (REST/SDK) with reference docs, an OpenAPI spec, a stable machine interface beyond CLI scripting, and independent evidence of programmatic use.
